Sections, stable-first: (1) THE MAP — the richest areas at steering grain; (2) AREA INDEX — every other area, named, one line each; (3) ACTIVE SURFACE — recent + load-bearing witnesses; (4) FOCUS — material loaded for your focus, LAST. The map and index never vary with your focus; your per-call material is at the end.

^-marked entries are compressed stubs carrying child addresses. Their narration and any surfaced witness quotes are verbatim-accurate — quote them as-is — but a stub carries no provenance (source, date, supersession). Expand (aswritten_expand with the IRIs you need) before any claim that turns on WHEN or by WHOM something was said, or whether it is still the current framing. Witness-depth sections below already carry full provenance.

Deciding where to go: each mapped area's narration tells you the SPAN of what lives under it; the area index names everything else. Expand a subtree when its narration (or name) shows your subject plausibly lives there — you'll get the trajectory, the variants, and the verbatim witness. But be strict about absence: if neither the map's narrations nor the index's names substantively cover your subject, it is NOT in this perspective — say so rather than expanding a loose thematic match (a word-overlap is not coverage). Decide from the map; expand to ground.

positions.name: OwnedPerspectiveAsRetainedAsset
positions.frame: does the value of intelligence come from ownership and retained perspective rather than from the substrate or rental arrangement it runs on?
positions.why: Both expressions are aphoristic, plain-spoken maxims (register mint-1) built on matched antithesis/metaphor (style), delivered at settled, low-arousal calm-positive affect and market-pricing relational framing that treats intelligence and perspective as goods whose mode of possession — owned/kept versus rented/commodity — determines their worth. The value read (autonomy, self-enhancement mint-1) and conviction read (src-3 pitched at 'principle' — creed-level, unargued bedrock; src-2 at 'claim' — an unhedged but argued distinction) both point the same direction even though they sit at different conviction heights: src-2 supplies the categorical distinction, src-3 supplies the constitutive stake in what's kept. The tension between claim-level and principle-level commitment is held, not resolved, within the frame.

Both are content-level assertions about where value resides in an intelligence system — a subject the document itself frames as a recurring thesis ('the individually-owned-intelligence thesis') meant to be connected to by future navigation, not a one-time fact or measurement. No existing strata or narrative leaf was supplied for this envelope (both structures are empty), and nothing in the perspective's map or focus section covers this theme (per the pass-2 settled binding), so this is a fresh subject with no close analog to extend, contradict, or see — it stands as a new, standalone leaf.
